scrap.x: Scrap is a resource used for [[crafting|crafting]] in Coral Island. It can be further refined into [[glass|glass]] or used as is.

There are no [[quest|quests]] item that currently need this item.

3 bronze kelp essences of any quality are needed for the [[lake-temple|Rare Resources offering]] in the Rare altar.

hay.x: Hay is a [[resource|resource]] used for [[crafting|crafting]] and feeding [[farm-animal|farm animal]]s.
The quality of hay can be increased at the [[laboratory|Laboratory]] to improve the quality of animal products.
It can be gathered by cutting grass and weeds with a [[scythe|scythe]], breaking destructible boxes, or converting [[fiber|fiber]] with a [[dehydrator|dehydrator]].

[[silo|Silo]]s can be used to store extra hay so that it can pulled from dispenser in a [[barn|barn]] or [[coop|coop]] to feed animals. Each silo adds an additional 300 storage to its capacity. Once a silo is built, any hay harvested with a scythe will be stored in it until it is full. Hay can only be removed from storage through the barn or coop dispensers. [[auto-feeder|Auto feeder]] will automatically collect hay from silo and put it to the feeder.

The [[laboratory|Laboratory]] offers upgrade to the player's seeds, plants, fruit trees, and hay. Each upgrade costs some essence produced from [[kelp|kelps]] using the [[extractor|Extractor]] and game money.

Upgrades purchased at the laboratory apply to all hay in the player's inventory or planted on the farm and all future hay purchases with no increase in price. Once upgraded, there will be higher chance in getting higher quality of all animal produce.
There are no [[quest|quests]] that currently need this item.

hardwood.x: Hardwood is a [[resource|resource]] used for [[carpenter|construction]] and [[tool|tool]] [[sanchez-brothers-blacksmith|upgrades]].

Hardwood can be gathered by chopping logs around the island with a [[axe|Silver Axe]] or occasionally found in destructible boxes. One fallen log can be found on the waterfall path east of the forest [[cavern|mine]] which grants the player five hardwood, and 1-7 fallen logs spawn daily in the mid-forest area that unlocks after six [[lake-temple|offering bundles]] are completed. Additional hardwood can be found in the [[deep-forest|deep forest]] that unlocks after fourteen offering bundles are completed. Hardwood is also located on the players farm, these do not reappear once exhausted. The hardwood found on the players farm requires a [[axe|Gold Axe]] to harvest but can also be acquired by using [[explosive-i|Explosive I]].
There are no [[quest|quests]] that currently need this item.
